knowledge_gaps: The residual has an unexamined ranking property: without clipping, log(p(j|i)/q_j) = log(1+c_ij/(alpha*q_j)) − log(1+n_i/alpha). With candidate-independent anchor weights, the second term cancels in candidate rankings. Row support therefore does not independently attenuate ranking changes; clipping can change this behavior. Include an explicit support-weighting ablation.

Cross-fitting is underspecified. The diagnostic loader supplies no user IDs, so recent item IDs alone cannot reliably identify the user's excluded fold. Specify fold propagation without changing the public loader contract, and ensure each training-position residual uses only its causal sequence prefix.

The report lacks exact folds, hyperparameter ranges, prior smoothing, clipping thresholds, recency weights, score calibration, and trial allocation. It also needs paired validation uncertainty and protection against repeatedly tuning on the same 800 users.

Originality 5/10 and difficulty 3/10 are provisional: established sequential nearest-neighbor and Markov baselines are missing, while fold-aware diagnostics, sparse full-catalog scoring, and predictor parity add implementation work. No validation evidence yet supports preferring this residual over the objective-focused alternative.
